home.subtitle: Aqoonso dhagxaanta qaaliga ah, macdanta iyo wax kale adigoo isticmaalaya baaris khibrad leh.
home.deepScanUnlocked: Iskaanka Qoto-dheer waa la furay — iskaan kastaa wuxuu helayaa baaris buuxda oo khibrad leh.

settings.title: Dejinta
settings.explanationSimpleDesc: Sharaxaad fudud oo Ingiriis ah, u fudud bilowga

privacy.dataUsageBody: Sawirradaada iskaanka si gaar ah ayaa loo kaydiyaa, waxaana loo isticmaalaa oo keliya in lagu aqoonsado tusaalahaaga iyo in la hagaajiyo saxnaanta. Goobta waa mid guud oo aan sax ahayn. Rukunnada waxaa lagu maamulaa oo keliya websaydka — barnaamijku waligiis lacag ma qaado.

scanner.noGemstone: Ma jiro dhagax qaali ah oo la helay. Fadlan dhagax qaali ah hor dhig kamaradda.
scanner.detected: Dhagax qaali ah ayaa la helay
scanner.holdRotate: Dhagaxa si adag u hay, ka dibna si tartiib ah u rogrog
scanner.analyzing: Waa la aqoonsanayaa tusaalahaaga — waxay qaadan kartaa ilaa 30 ilbiriqsi…
scanner.cameraNeeded: LuulScan wuxuu u baahan yahay kamaradda si uu u iskaano dhagxaanta.

history.title: Kaydkaaga
history.emptyHint: Iskaan dhagaxaaga ugu horreeya si aad u bilowdo kaydkaaga.
history.offlineShowingSaved: Internet ma jiro — waxaa la muujinayaa xogtii kaydsanayd {{age}}
history.refreshFailedShowingSaved: Lama cusboonaysiin karin — waxaa la muujinayaa xogtii kaydsanayd {{age}}
history.offlineDetailUnavailableTitle: Lama heli karo marka internet-ku maqan yahay
history.offlineDetailUnavailableHint: Iskaankan hore uma furin marka internet-ku maqnaa, sidaas darteed wax lagu kaydiyay qalabkan wali ma jiraan.

start.heading: Bilow Sahaminta
start.body: App-ku wuxuu akhrinayaa meesha aad joogto, wuxuu ogaanayaa dhagaxa hoostaada, kadibna wuxuu kugu hagayaa dhulka ugu rajada wanaagsan ee kuu dhow. Internet uma baahna.

status.paused: Waa la joojiyay — hagitaanku wuu soo noqonayaa marka aad sii wadato
status.sensorError: Meesha lama heli karo — hagitaanka waa la joojiyay
status.reasoning: Waxaan ku cusboonaysiinayaa waxa aad heshay…
status.noTarget: Bartilmaameed lug lagu tago ma jiro — eeg hoose

here.label: MEESHA AAD JOOGTO
here.noGeology: Halkan dhagax la sawiray lama hayo
here.bestHere: Kani waa dhulka ugu rajada badan ee kuu dhow — ka shaqee ka hor inta aanad dhaqaaqin.

target.label: HALKAN U SOCO
target.elevationUnknown: Xog dherer oo labada barood daboolaysa ma jirto

none.noStrongerBody: Wax kuu dhow oo ku filan lama helin. Halkan ka shaqee, ama dhaqaaq oo mar kale hubi.
none.noKnowledgeBody: App-ku aqoon uu offline ku hayo aaggan ma leh, sidaas darteed jiho ma malaynayo.

evidence.heading: Waad timid
evidence.body: Qor waxa aad aragto. Waxa aad qorto ayaa beddelaya waxa app-ku kuu talinayo — sidaas darteed sheeg waxa dhab ahaan jira, ee ha sheegin waxa aad rajaynayso.

pack.none: Xog dhagax lama rakibin — hagitaan lama heli karo
pack.stale: Aqoon v{{version}} · {{days}} maalmood jir · waa laga yaabaa inay duugowday

reason.intersection: Jeex dhul iyo xudduud dhagax ayaa isku tagaya {{distance}} gudaheed

location.lookupHint: Geli koordinaytada si aad u aragto dhagaxa halkaas. Kaama dhaqaajinayo.
location.inspectingBanner: Waxaad eegaysaa {{lat}}, {{lng}} — ma aha meeshaad joogto

evidence2.title: CADDAYMAHA AGTAADA
evidence2.farTitle: WAXA UGU DHOW EE LA OGYAHAY, OO FOG
evidence2.farHint: Waa ka fog tahay socod hal mar ah. Waxay ku qoran tahay Halkudhegyada gobolka, halkaas oo aad ka bilaabi karto socodka.

destination.label: BARTA AAD DOORATAY
destination.waitingFix: Sugaya GPS-ka si uu jiho u siiyo…

net.downloading: Waxaa la soo dejinayaa sawirada dayax-gacmeedka…

sheet.nothingHereFar: Bartilmaameed lug lagu gaadho ma jiro. Dhulka khariidadaysan ee ugu dhow waa {{distance}} xagga {{compass}} — {{transport}}, qiyaastii {{travel}}.
sheet.unitUnknown: Barta aad joogto qayb khariidadaysan ma haysato.
sheet.faultAhead: Jeex la khariidadeeyay ayaa {{distance}} kaa jira, taasoo macdanta kulmin karta.
sheet.regionalLead: Halka ugu dhow ee la khariidadeeyay: {{distance}} xagga {{compass}}. {{transport}}, qiyaastii {{travel}}.

arrived.title: Waad gaadhay bartilmaameedka
arrived.body: Meel wanaagsan oo la baaro. Sawir waxa aad arki karto.

regional.title: HALKUDHEGYADA GOBOLKA
regional.hint: Waxyaabaha la khariidadeeyay ee ku jira xirmada aqoonta, masaafo kasta. Masaafadu waa kala-saarid, ma aha diidmo.
regional.none: Xirmada aqoonta wax la khariidadeeyay kama hayso meelna halkan ka jirta.

gps.title: GPS
gps.warnPoor: GPS-ku halkan wuxuu saxan yahay qiyaastii ±{{m}} mitir. Masaafada iyo imaanshaha intaas ayay le'eg yihiin.
gps.warnStale: {{s}} il-biriqsi meel cusub lama helin. Waxa la muujinayo waxaa laga yaabaa inay tahay meeshii aad joogtay.
gps.warnNone: GPS weli lama helin. Masaafada iyo jihada waa la sugayaa, lama qiyaasayo.
gps.calibrate: Kombaaska waa in la habeeyaa — taleefanka u dhaqaaji sida sideed.

export.title: SOO SAAR DIIWAANKA GOOBTA
export.hint: {{count}} meel oo goob leh. GPX gacan-qabsi, CSV xisaab, GeoJSON QGIS.
export.empty: Meelna weli goob ma haysato — wax la soo saaro ma jiro.
